name: @red-cup-engineering/npm-registry-a2a-projection-service
description: Translates between npm registry data and A2A message shapes: builds the A2A request/response protocol for asking a registry for its snapshot, and answers one such request given a registry root and URL. Has no server and does not listen on a port — a web server that wants to serve a registry over A2A composes this with @red-cup-engineering/a2a-contracted-agent-service.

scripts.verify: node --check src/protocol.mjs && node --check src/snapshot.mjs && node --check scripts/execute-a2a-task.mjs && node --test test/*.test.mjs
